verdict.rationale: Alerting-to-webhook routing is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence that Datadog monitors or SLO alerts can send notifications to registrable outbound HTTP webhooks, or trigger automated remediation or agents. The Monitors and Integrations entries are bare titles with no content about webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
